title: Account Executive and Accounts Manager
description:
Job Description Accounts Manager / Senior Accounts Manager 
 Company Name: Linen and Beyond Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: Bargur, Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu
 Salary: 55,000 65,000 per month
 Experience: 1012 years
 Industry: Textile Manufacturing / Export / Hospitality Linen
 About the Company 
Linen and Beyond Pvt. Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and export of premium hospitality linen products, including bed sheets, napkins, pillow covers, table linen, chair covers and other textile products supplied to hotels and hospitality businesses.
 Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced Accounts Manager who can independently manage the complete accounts and finance function of our manufacturing and export business. The candidate should have strong knowledge of Tally, GST, taxation, financial reporting, finalization of accounts and statutory compliance.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Accounts & Finance Management 
 Manage day-to-day accounting operations and maintain accurate financial records. Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and bank reconciliation. Monitor cash flow, fund requirements and working capital. Prepare monthly financial statements, MIS reports and management reports. Handle cost accounting, expense monitoring and budget control. 2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance 
 Handle GST returns, GST reconciliation, TDS calculations and returns. Coordinate income tax matters, tax audits and statutory audits. Ensure timely compliance with applicable statutory requirements. Maintain proper documentation for audits and assessments. 3. Financial Statements & Audit 
 Independently handle monthly, quarterly and annual closing of accounts. Prepare profit and loss statements, balance sheets and trial balances. Coordinate with auditors, consultants, banks and other financial institutions. Ensure accurate accounting records and compliance with applicable accounting standards. 4. Manufacturing & Export Accounting 
 Manage manufacturing cost accounting, product costing and expense allocation. Monitor raw material, work-in-progress and finished goods accounting. Reconcile inventory records with physical stock and production reports. Handle export sales accounting, foreign currency transactions and export-related documentation. Coordinate with production, purchase, stores, sales and HR departments for financial information. 5. Payroll & Team Management 
 Supervise salary accounting, employee advances, reimbursements and related entries. Coordinate with HR for payroll, PF, ESI and other applicable statutory deductions. Lead and monitor the accounts team and ensure timely completion of accounting activities. 6. Banking & Management Reporting 
 Manage bank reconciliation, payment planning and vendor payment schedules. Prepare receivables ageing, payables ageing and outstanding reports. Provide financial analysis and reports to management for decision-making. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Required Skills 
 Strong working knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime . Excellent knowledge of GST, TDS, taxation and statutory compliance. Experience in finalization of accounts and financial statement preparation. Knowledge of manufacturing accounting, inventory accounting and product costing. Working knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, PivotTables and financial reporting. Good analytical, communication, leadership and problem-solving skills. Eligibility Criteria 
 B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification. 1012 years of relevant experience in accounts and finance. Experience in manufacturing, textile, export or similar industries is preferred. Ability to independently manage the complete accounts function. Strong knowledge of Tally and applicable Indian accounting and taxation requirements.

Key Skills: Finance,Budgeting,Gst,Taxation,Payables,Accounts payable,Tally,Ledger
